customManagers.description: devkit pin: the tag and the commit it peels to, in devkit.toml
devkit's parent POM: its version is the tag without the leading v
Dev Services image: Testcontainers rejects tag@sha256:, so the tag sits in the comment above the digest-only image name

packageRules.description: devkit-parent is published to no Maven repository; the regex manager above owns it
devkit.toml and the parent POM version must move together, or every Maven target fails
Dev Services must run the same postgres build as docker-compose.yml's db

postgres stays on 18.x: a database major is a person's PR, because compose's data volume needs pg_upgrade (CI's fresh Dev Services database never shows it), and its mount path and quarkus.datasource.db-version name 18 where no manager reads them
Tags stay exact, never floating: the Alpine version counts as part of postgres's version, so moving to a newer Alpine is an ordinary update rather than a suffix Renovate never leaves
Temurin on Alpine: the respin (25.0.4.1_1) and the Alpine version count as version parts, which the LTS preset's versioning rejects or ignores; its LTS cap still applies
Temurin on Ubuntu: the same, with the codename as the compatibility, which no version order can move past (the image is unused, see #75)
